:::{#lem-cov-estimator-score}
#### Covariance of an unbiased estimator with the score

Under the assumptions of @exr-cov-estimator-score,
an unbiased estimator $T$ of $\param$ has covariance 1 with the score:

$$
\Covs{T}{\score(\vX \mid \param)} = 1
$$ {#eq-cov-estimator-score}

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-cov-estimator-score.

:::
